fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: {name} 买了 4 只香囊，每只 9 元，付了 40 元，找回多少元？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: There are 78 zongzi on the plate. The family eats 75. How many are left?
questions.q_zh: 盘子里有 78 只粽子，一家人吃了 75 只，还剩几只？

questions.subject: language
questions.q_en: What does 船 mean in English?
questions.q_zh: 「船」的英文意思是？
questions.explain_en: 船 means boat, as in 龙舟 dragon boat.
questions.explain_zh: 船就是 boat，龙舟就是 dragon boat。

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: In Lujiazui, the tall modern towers stand across the river from the ____.
questions.q_zh: 在陆家嘴，高高的新楼和____隔江相望。
questions.explain_en: Lujiazui faces the Bund across the Huangpu.
questions.explain_zh: 陆家嘴和外面的外滩隔着黄浦江。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海地标（陆家嘴/外滩/新天地）

questions.subject: duanwu
questions.q_en: The doorman at Xintiandi says "Happy Dragon Boat Festival!" and holds out a little bag of fragrant herbs. What is it?
questions.q_zh: 新天地的礼宾说“端午安康！”，递过来一只装着香草的小布袋。那是什么？
questions.explain_en: A sachet is a small bag of fragrant herbs worn at this festival.
questions.explain_zh: 香囊是过端午时戴的香草小布袋。
questions.qtype_zh: 端午习俗（粽子/龙舟/艾草/五彩绳）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Along the Bund there are 7 dragon-boat teams, each with 7 paddlers. How many paddlers are there?
questions.q_zh: 外滩边有 7 支龙舟队，每队有 7 名桨手，一共有多少名桨手？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the Bund, 20 race flags are shared equally by 4 dragon-boat teams. How many does each team get?
questions.q_zh: 在外滩，20 面比赛旗平均分给 4 支龙舟队，每队几面？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 35 zongzi sit on the trays at Xintiandi, and 3/5 of them are sweet bean. How many zongzi are sweet bean?
questions.q_zh: 新天地托盘上有 35 只粽子，其中 3/5 是豆沙馅，豆沙粽有多少只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A rectangular zongzi stall at Xintiandi is 19 dm long and 4 dm wide. Flora ties five-color thread once around its edge. How many decimetres of thread does she need?
questions.q_zh: 新天地一个长方形粽子摊位长 19 分米、宽 4 分米。Flora 用五彩绳沿边绕一圈，需要多少分米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A welcome mat at the Xintiandi door is 12 m long and 11 m wide. What area does it cover in square metres?
questions.q_zh: 新天地门口的迎宾地毯长 12 米、宽 11 米，面积是多少平方米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora rides 8 km from Lujiazui to the Bund, then walks 150 m along the flood wall. How many metres does she travel in all?
questions.q_zh: Flora 从陆家嘴骑 8 千米到外滩，又沿防汛墙走了 150 米，一共走了多少米？
questions.qtype_zh: 单位换算（米↔厘米、千克↔克）
